name: indulgence
quote: A big piece of chocolate cake please.
description: Engaging in something pleasurable that part of your mind knows is not necessary and has downsides. It may come with a flash of excitement or guilt.
perceptions: You are engaging in a pleasurable activity.
You know the activity to be unhealthy and perhaps selfish.
But the activity doesn't break any solid social rules.

guidance.description: If indulgence is the result of failed willpower and you want some tips on practicing, see the entry for willpower.

variations.name: indulgence signaling
variations.description: Engaging in something pleasurable but potentially unhealthy due to social motivations. Also known as 'peer pressure'.
perceptions: A social group rewards you for engaging in an activity which there's good reason to avoid.
The activity itself has pleasurable aspects despite known downsides.

guidance.description: If desired, there are various resources available for how to gently resist social pressure.

variations.name: guilty pleasure
variations.description: May come with guilt for not being able to resist.
perceptions: You are engaging in a pleasurable activity.
You know the activity to be unhealthy and perhaps selfish.
But the activity doesn't break any solid social rules.
Still you know you should not be doing it.

commentaries.quote: Indulgence is an unsuccessful encounter with temptation.
The greatest crimes do not arise from a want of feeling for others but from an over-sensibilit y for ourselves and an over-indulgence to our own desires.

While overeating would be seen by some as an indulgence of self, it is in fact a profound rejection of self. It is a moment of self-betrayal and self-punishment, and anything but a commitment to one's own well-being.
